title: NO EVENT RING OVER A BODY YOU CANNOT SEE
why: The cloud review of 2026-10-15, finding 6, checked against the code. The ring and the name of the bounty pillager (BOUNTY $1,500) and the ring of the convoy and the Overseer rampage were drawn on the screen over walls and the fog and followed the body wherever it stood, so a pillager behind a wall or in the dark was pointed out to the pixel; the coolant glints sat on every rich crate seen or not. The rule of the game is line of sight: the ring and the name now draw only while the body is seen (a teammate sight counts), and stay a pinned mark with its name on the minimap and the sector map. The coolant glints draw on the crates you can see.
now: Event rings and names over a hunter or a convoy show only where you can see it.
